summary: R228 extends R227 source-log provenance with per-log latest Startup/Bootstrap maps and explicit completeness accounting. Multi-session reports can now distinguish complete startup/bootstrap evidence from partial or truncated sessions without inferring missing evidence; the coverage remains diagnostic-only and NativeDrawPath remains dormant.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered authenticated vr-dx11-native-r71 HEAD 93188a1ee1e406cce65e6c4e9c3448925223462c. Read AGENTS.md, VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_INDEX.md, QUEUE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md, CONVERSION_LANE_STATE.json, VR_AUTODEV_STATE.json, VR_RUN_STATE.md, VR_REGRESSION_KNOWLEDGE.json, VR_PROBLEM_HISTORY.md and Issue #14. R227 is durable and was not repeated.

C1_REVIEW.finding: R227 attaches source_log to Startup/Bootstrap entries, but the report still exposes only global lists. Consumers cannot directly determine which recognized logs have no startup/bootstrap record, and repeated records require ad-hoc scanning to identify the latest per session.

review_lenses.architecture: Keep the fix inside the offline DX11 census analyzer/test/verifier; no runtime renderer, OpenXR, DX9Ex, transport or native draw routing changes.
review_lenses.stereo_correctness: No WVP, projection, HUD, sky/effect or recenter behavior changes.
review_lenses.performance: Offline report aggregation only; runtime hot path is unchanged.
review_lenses.adversarial: Two recognized logs are supplied; one has repeated bootstrap records and the other has no bootstrap record. The report must select the latest bootstrap for the complete log and expose incomplete coverage without inventing evidence.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Added LatestStartupByLog, LatestBootstrapByLog and StartupBootstrapCoverage with explicit per-source completeness flags, exported the same coverage under ActivationEvidence as DiagnosticOnly/ActivationProof=false, added a partial-session regression fixture, and added source-graph drift guards.

C3_VALIDATE.evidence: Pre-change review shows no LatestStartupByLog, LatestBootstrapByLog or startup/bootstrap completeness object. Exact-SHA hosted gate is required after publication.

C5_PACKAGE.reason: Offline analyzer evidence-integrity/reporting change only; no runtime binary behavior or distributable package identity change intended.

C6_STATE.exact_next_action: Publish the R228 material result without CI skip, require its exact-SHA Backend Conversion Gate, then persist PASS task/lane bookkeeping separately while keeping RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED.

regression_assessment.evidence: Changed paths are offline analyzer/test/verifier plus task bookkeeping only. No runtime source, transport, protected DX9Ex baseline or HMD-visible behavior changes.

exact_next_action: Publish the R228 multi-log startup/bootstrap coverage material result without CI skip and require its exact-SHA Backend Conversion Gate.
